## JavaScript API

An object containing metadata to be embedded in the video. See [here](/docs/metadata) for which metadata is accepted.

## Command line

Metadata to be embedded in the video. See [here](/docs/metadata) for which metadata is accepted.<br />The parameter must be in the format of `--metadata key=value` and can be passed multiple times.

## CLI flag

```text
--metadata <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#metadata)
- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#metadata)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#metadata)
- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#metadata)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#metadata)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#metadata)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#metadata)
